name: PAR-Q questionnaire
review_or_signing_authority: Specifically authorised evidence reviewer; clinical questions/decisions require appropriate reviewed process
workflow_consequence: Submit applicable onboarding/activity requirement; no automatic fitness or entry approval

name: Emergency contact form
review_or_signing_authority: Assigned onboarding reviewer only where company process requires
workflow_consequence: Required onboarding checklist; contact details not public/reception questionnaire

name: House rules acknowledgement
workflow_consequence: Record exact rule version acknowledgement before required service gate

name: Membership agreement
completed_or_issued_by: Actual member/authorised signatory; payer and beneficiary separate
workflow_consequence: Issue accepted plan agreement; signing is not confirmation of collected payment

name: Membership change or freeze confirmation
completed_or_issued_by: Source issuer; member reviews actual transition
workflow_consequence: Confirmed source freeze/cancel/reinstate effect, not template edit applying change

name: PT client onboarding form
completed_or_issued_by: PT client or verified action-specific guardian
workflow_consequence: Limited account and qualifying appointment/pass gates; no full gym membership

name: Hourly PT service terms
workflow_consequence: Accepted hourly service/price/terms snapshot; prepaid bundles excluded

name: Trial or guest terms acknowledgement
completed_or_issued_by: Actual trial participant or verified authorised guardian
workflow_consequence: Only configured trial purpose/window; no invented free visit or active membership

name: Guardian authority and action-right review
completed_or_issued_by: Claiming adult supplies actual authority evidence
review_or_signing_authority: Authorised relationship reviewer verifies specific rights
workflow_consequence: Claim does not grant child data; separate book/pay/sign/read/contact/collect rights

name: Dependent activity consent
workflow_consequence: Specific approved activity/requirement; no invented legal age or blanket parent assumption

name: Staff employment contract
completed_or_issued_by: Actual employer representative and actual staff signatory where required
review_or_signing_authority: Authorised HR/owner with pay fields as granted
workflow_consequence: Source employment contract version; signed PDF upload or composed issue, no automatic payroll filing

name: Staff onboarding details
completed_or_issued_by: Actual employee or authorised HR source editor
workflow_consequence: Private employment data; role/financial privileges not self-editable profile fields

name: Staff emergency contact form
completed_or_issued_by: Actual employee or authorised HR editor
review_or_signing_authority: Assigned HR owner only as needed
workflow_consequence: Private staff purpose, not merged into unrelated member emergency record by assumption

name: Staff policy or SOP acknowledgement
workflow_consequence: Exact applicable policy version; read/download alone is not acknowledgement

name: Training or qualification evidence
completed_or_issued_by: Actual staff member or authorised training uploader
workflow_consequence: File submission is not verified qualification; expiry from reviewed source/policy

name: One-to-one meeting record
review_or_signing_authority: Restricted HR role; employee visibility per explicit case rights
workflow_consequence: Private factual record; attendance is not employee agreement with every note

name: Disciplinary case correspondence
completed_or_issued_by: Authorised case issuer and actual recipient if acknowledgement requested
workflow_consequence: Separate receipt/acknowledgement from agreement/admission; applicable reviewed process required

name: Approved timesheet statement
completed_or_issued_by: Authorised source reviewer issues; employee sees own statement
workflow_consequence: Approved actual hours evidence; not automatic statutory payslip calculation

name: Payslip delivery
review_or_signing_authority: Scoped payroll owner and intended employee access
workflow_consequence: Deliver actual issued/imported payslip securely; no pay amount in external preview

name: Rental coach agreement
completed_or_issued_by: Actual authorised gym representative and rental coach
workflow_consequence: Freeze rental mode/rent/scope; not employed-coach earnings split or automatic banking payout

name: Coach credential evidence
workflow_consequence: Evidence validity and scope before permitted classes/PT, not unlimited member CRM

name: Supplier onboarding form
workflow_consequence: Supplier setup and contacts/credentials before assigned work; no proof of external provider authority

name: Contractor quote
workflow_consequence: Source quote submission; composed/uploaded output never self-approves spend

name: Contractor variation
workflow_consequence: New exact scope/version; prior quote approval does not approve variation

name: Contractor visit or job sheet
completed_or_issued_by: Assigned operative/organisation and authorised work owner
review_or_signing_authority: Authorised task verifier where evidence required
workflow_consequence: Same cleaning/maintenance/admin engine and individual proof; no copied independent task state

name: Work completion evidence form
workflow_consequence: Completion submission versus review/verification/closure separate; asset restoration independent

name: Supplier invoice submission
workflow_consequence: Actual source invoice/issuer/reference; upload/template publication not verified payable or cash paid

name: Customer invoice or charge statement
workflow_consequence: Issue source debt only through owning command; template render does not create second charge

name: Customer receipt
review_or_signing_authority: No new manual approval if existing authorised source confirms issue
workflow_consequence: Print/share/member-app delivery immutable; reprint is not new sale, refund or stock movement

name: Credit or refund confirmation
workflow_consequence: Credit-note debt effect and confirmed refund cash remain different document labels

name: Management report export
workflow_consequence: 62 definitions and frozen filter/as_of/completeness; no unapproved external scheduled mail

name: Operational letter
review_or_signing_authority: Reviewer appropriate to purpose; HR/legal if applicable
workflow_consequence: Generic composition cannot bypass restricted source case/data/purpose

name: Transactional notification layout
completed_or_issued_by: Current supported notification service acting on committed event
workflow_consequence: 91-event contract, generic private preview, no unsupported provider capability

name: Approved public policy or rules page
review_or_signing_authority: Content reviewer plus current public publisher
workflow_consequence: Publish only approved public wording; no private questionnaires/HR or signed record copies
